source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): use find+xargs for seed chmod — busybox-safe
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Syntax Error**: The parentheses in the find command must be escaped or quoted. Without proper escaping, the shell will interpret them as subshell operators, causing a syntax error and script failure. This will prevent the seed completion marker from being written, breaking the init container.
```suggestion
  find /nix-pvc/store -mindepth 1 \( -type f -o -type d \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r chmod a-w
```
